Campaigns: the frozen campaign q1-scoreboard-f6-current-master (hash 6c422770, freeze commit 1929c441) and five amendments, each with its own manifest, hash and ledger: A1 q1-scoreboard-f6-current-master-a1 (2f5db2a2), A2 -a2 (3eb38788), A3 -a3 (2ad97fef), A4 -a4 (fee2706d) and A4b -a4b (fff66e08). Every unit publishes from the campaign that ran it. Cells whose shards span campaigns (D8 gbrain, D8 graph pipeline, S1 temporal graph) merge once at the A4b launch commit d9fffb93; the merge code and the cell definitions it reads are identical across the F6 launch commits apart from expected hours, a launch-control field.

D8 gbrain (A1, A2): in the frozen campaign the canary c0 and shards c1 and c3 to c9 timed out on gbrain's /finish at the original finish budget, so every answer of theirs is ingest_degraded; those realizations are never published. The row takes c2 from the frozen campaign, c0 from A1 (finish budget sized from the largest conversation) and c1 and c3 to c9 from A2, each built afresh.

VM sweep (A3): from 16:33 to 16:36 UTC on 2026-10-30 another team's test of an unmerged runner change destroyed every Ubicloud VM in the project named without an expiry and older than 4 hours, 22 F6 VMs among them (S1 gbrain c0 to c9, S1 temporal graph c0 to c9, the S1 file agent and D8 graph pipeline c9). No realization from them is published. A3 relaunched S1 gbrain c0 to c9, S1 temporal graph c0 to c3 and D8 graph pipeline c9 from fresh stores, with VM names that carry an expiry and a watcher that saves each unit's spend every 30 minutes; A4 and A4b ran the rest.

S1 file agent (A4): resumed from the checkpoint the frozen campaign pulled before the sweep. Its store was ingested again, the 140 rows already answered were kept with their judgments, and only the questions without answers were answered (the harness's `answers` resume mode).

S1 temporal graph 0.31.2 publishes every shard that completed: c0 to c3 from A3 and c4 to c9 from A4b. Budget ledger fix (A4, commit 69adc404): the ledger now accepts a reservation that brings a run or the program exactly to its cap, within 1e-9 dollars. Before it, float rounding refused such a reservation by about 2e-14 dollars and held A3's last unit for 3 hours, until another lease settled below its reservation. No cell's rows changed.

Rows reused from Q1's A24 campaign (q1-scoreboard-sealed, launch commit 008b83fe) for ext-extract-first, ext-memory-bank, ext-graph-pipeline, ext-markdown-kb, ext-verbatim-session, baseline-none, baseline-recency and baseline-full-context, each declared in the F6 preregistration and passing eval/runner/q1/reuse-check.ts from 008b83fe to d9fffb93. baseline-hybrid and baseline-file-agent fail that check, so their S1 rows were rerun at the F6 tree and their S2b, S2a and S3 rows are not run. ext-temporal-graph's A24 rows were retired (its pinned configuration calls models its provider retired); F6 measures its 0.31.2 shipped defaults instead (configuration shipped-0.31).

S1 is descriptive and unranked: with 10 conversations Q1's power check detects only differences of about 13.6 points, so no S1 row leads, beats or trails another. Arm P is gbrain's headline row on every set; arms A0, A, B, C, D and E are measurements beside it. D8 is published here descriptively.

[FILL BEFORE PUBLISHING: D8 confirmatory family] The preregistered D8 family (P − A, D − A and B − A; exact two-sided McNemar on claude-sonnet-5-5's paired correct/incorrect, question-level paired bootstrap, Holm at 0.05) is not computed by eval/runner/scoreboard.ts; link its result here.

S1 file agent (A5): like the S1 hybrid, the A4 unit ran Q1's definition of its cell id, and its receipt is merged and published under that definition, as it ran. The two definitions have the same questions, readers, agent mode and canonical judge; Q1's also asks for frontier judges, ten judge repeats and 20 ingest-latency probes. F6's comparison reads only the canonical judge (judge_replicate 0), so it is what F6's definition would have produced; the extra work was paid inside the $3,100 cap. The cell runner now refuses an id both manifests define unless --manifest names one.
